why: book.sasquatchfarm.com (the operator's own booking engine, read 2026-11-25): RV site '$65 a night, $380 a week' for 2 adults, one flat rate on every date (no seasonal or weekday tier in the engine's quote code); even the weekly rate is $54.29 a night. Over the US$50 gate; gateways.py finds no gateway within 40 km (nearest Nashville 154 km), and it is not a Good Sam Park (trip_data/goodsam_parks.json: gs false, military true), so no exception applies.
name: Sasquatch Farm RV Park

fees.note: $65 a night for a full-hookup RV site, 2 adults and 2 children included; $380 a week; extra guest 12 and up $25 a night. Monthly $1,080, or $800 a month on a six-month commitment.

fees_source: https://book.sasquatchfarm.com/ read 2026-11-25: page BOOT 'ratesOther':{'rvNight':65,'rvWeek':380,...,'xAdult':25,'xKid':15}; app.js step 1 'RV site' = rvNight + ' a night, ' + rvWeek + ' a week'; quote(): RV nights priced as weeks at rvWeek plus remaining nights at rvNight, no season or weekend tier (cabins alone carry fall/reg rates); '2 adults and 2 children are included'. https://sasquatchfarm.com/pages/monthly-stays.html read 2026-11-25: 'Less than 6 months $1,080 /month', '6 months or more $800 /month'.
flags: Otherwise it looks like a real nightly RV park: 52 full-hookup sites (50/30/20 A), pull-thru and back-in, 'big rig friendly', own website + phone + its own booking engine selling single nights, Google 4.6/193 (from the lead, not re-read). It also sells monthly sites (by application, $1,000 deposit) - nightly share not measured, since it fails on price first.
Discounts seen and not applied: 10% military ($58.50, still over); Harvest Hosts members $55 a night (still over, and a membership rate).

Duplicate check: no entry by name and none within 10 km of the pin. No waterfront audit run (skipped on price); the operator mentions 'lakeside spots' among its numbered sites and separate hike-in FCFS lake tent sites on its two private lakes; unmeasured.
